facts.text: NAU offers FOCUSED bachelor's degrees requiring 135 quarter credits and around 30 courses, compared with 180 credits in traditional programs.

sources.title: 85 Years of Evolution: How National American University Continues to Adapt to Working Adults - National
sources.quote: These programs are designed around 135 quarter credits and approximately 30 courses, compared with the 180 quarter credits and approximately 40 courses generally required in NAU's traditional bachelor's degree structure.
